sources.entry: Logo Designer Skill by neonwatty - Create and evolve SVG logos with Claude Code. Turns a project brief into distinct concepts you can compare side by side, then guides refinement, checks favicon legibility, and exports production-ready PNGs.

summary.one_liner: A Claude Code skill that guides an agent through an interview, SVG logo concept exploration, refinement, and PNG export.
summary.what_it_does: The skill runs a four-phase workflow: an interview about brand, audience, and aesthetic preferences; generation of 3-5 distinct SVG concepts shown side by side for comparison; iterative refinement of a chosen direction (color, layout, detail); and export of final PNGs at 16, 32, 48, 192, 512, 1024, and 2048 px. The README says it activates automatically when the user asks the agent to design a logo. The README also mentions a favicon legibility check in the summary description, but the README body does not detail how that check works. The README links to a separate visual canvas tool called Lineage Logo for manually fine-tuning shape, size, color, and spacing after a design is chosen.
use_cases: Design a logo for a new app or project
Compare several logo concepts side by side
Iterate on an SVG logo's colors and layout
Export logo PNGs at standard icon sizes
Check how a logo reads at favicon size
how_to_run: Ask your agent to use the skill, or point the agent at the repo to install it
Prompt the agent with something like 'Create a logo for my project'
notable: Four-phase workflow: interview, explore, refine, export
Generates 3-5 distinct SVG concepts shown in a side-by-side preview
Optional companion canvas (Lineage Logo) for manual fine-tuning
caveats: README does not describe installation details beyond cloning the repo and asking the agent to install it
Fine-tuning step relies on a separate external tool, Lineage Logo
keywords: make a logo for my project
